Description:
Comments for any page on your Umbraco 17 site. Add the Comments block to a Block List or Block Grid, or add the Commentable composition to a document type.

Every comment is checked by the same rules engine as Community Forum, for spam, profanity, links and disguised words, plus your own word lists. Members of a Moderators member group can approve and remove comments on the page itself, without a backoffice account. Administrators have a queue in the backoffice, shared with the forum if you install both.

Also includes one level of replies, emoji, editing and deleting your own comments, member avatars, reporting, and a setting to hold every comment on a page for review.

Commenting needs a signed-in member. In this version comments are not stored per language, so every language version of a page shares one set. Optional AI review is available through the DigitalWonderlab.CommunityAi package on NuGet. Free to use.
